title: Petőfi Sándor, a forradalom költője (Sándor Petőfi, Poet of the Revolution)
grammar: Adverbial Participles, Rhetorical Imperatives & National Symbols Register

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say who Petőfi was and how long he lived.
I can say why Petőfi joined General Bem's army, using azért, hogy.
I can name the Battle of Segesvár and say that Petőfi's fate is disputed.
I can use six new words about Petőfi, such as lánglelkű and hősi halál.
